summary: Anima-Nipissing and Brigstocke are two firelookout.ca records near Latchford, Ontario; no build date or staffing found, and today's state is unconfirmed.

facts.design: steel tower with an octagonal cupola (Brigstocke record)
facts.status_note: No source gives a current status; the trail listing does not say whether the tower can be climbed.

access.note: Hiking trail listed by the Ontario Trails Council, which says it does not own or manage any trails.

visit.trail_note: 1.5 km groomed path; park at the third turn-around on the last road to the left before the government dock on Anima Nipissing Lake; a red blaze marks the route.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Firelookout.ca gives 437 m for the Anima-Nipissing record and 394 m for the Brigstocke record. The two sets of listed coordinates put the records about 360 m apart; that distance is a calculation from the coordinates, not a figure the site prints. Both elevations are kept in the story and neither is chosen.

notes_for_editor: Thin record: two firelookout.ca pages (one per name), the Canada Lookouts Ontario index, and the Ontario Trails Council trail page. The brief merges Anima-Nipissing and Brigstocke as one site; firelookout.ca keeps them apart, so an editor should decide whether to merge them. Not used: a 1931 Canada Lookouts item about a Lake Nipissing lookout near Powassan (a different tower); a blog passage about the Temagami tower. Unverified leads from search snippets only, which fetch_text did not confirm: a Facebook post (Jo's Tree Service) saying MNR deemed the Brigstocke tower unsafe, and a nastawgantrails.org trail summary reading 'Tower removed'. Check both before writing the fate. The Brigstocke record's 'proposed 1985 repeater' note is the only dated event in the sources read. Fact-check 2026-10-20: the trail page carries a timestamp matching the check date, so it gives no listing date; the story no longer calls the listing undated.
